BiblicalUsage: A layer is a course of building, and the temple's wall is specified course by course: three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber, with the expenses given out of the king's house. The word is the single row in the rising wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the temple rises one layer at a time, and the king's decree counts every row — God's house is built to measure.
